name: Austin Peay State University
oos_note: Public university. Non-resident undergraduate tuition & fees, Clarksville campus, full-time 12 hrs/semester: $7,872/semester ($6,960 tuition + $912 program service fees) x 2 = $15,744/year. Source: APSU Student Account Services undergraduate tuition page, Fall 2026/Spring 2027.
